preparedTransaction.gasCaveat: Refresh MetaMask gas and total fee including Base L1 data fee. Routed envelope gas can differ. No fixed gas or nonce is prescribed.

directSimulation.label: Actual current buyer account direct operator fund call

routedSimulation.label: Actual current MetaMask v1.3.0 delegated buyer self-execution; no overrides

routingLimitations: No state, balance, code overrides or new authorization list used. Actual current buyer delegation is used. Direct and self-execution paths prove exact buyer identity, 1 USDC custody transfer, PaymentAuthorized, OrderFunded and all post-state invariants. Unknown future relayer/signature envelopes, extra calls and delegation changes are not validated. Require exact inner fund call and independently verify the mined outcome before any retry.
